title: [FREE KEY] BARRAGE | OP AUTO FARM | PERMANENT KEY IN DISCORD
features:
BARRAGE - [ALIENS] Rope an Animal

Update Log & Feature List (2026-09-27)

FEATURE EXCLUSIVES & BYPASSES





Core Catching, Riding & Progression Bypasses:





Lasso Teleport: Teleports directly beside the best-paying animal on any island and throws the game’s own lasso. Follow-up throws use the server’s response timing down to a 0.45-second floor instead of the normal 1.25-second client lock.



Lasso Aura: Lets Stay In Place rope any animal already within lasso range without moving your character.



Auto Steer: Automatically steers every ride, including manual rides, toward the finish line where Guardians stop while sidestepping obstacles along the way.



Teleport Home Mid-Ride: Optional ride bypass that asks the game to teleport you home while still riding. If the server keeps the ride active, it automatically falls back to normal riding for the rest of the session.



Remote Pad Claim: Claims pad income remotely by activating each claim plate from anywhere, only moving to the pad if the server requires proximity.



Instant Power Boost: Instantly answers every 2x Power popup as soon as it appears so boost windows do not time out.



Player Mods: Includes Speed beyond your normal Speed cap, Fly, Noclip, Jump Boost, and Infinite Jump.

CATCHING & RIDE AUTOMATION





Auto Catch:





Auto Catch: Fully automates animal catching with keybind support. Features Presets (Smart Progression, Safe Only, Lasso Aura, Rare Hunter), Catch Actions (Lasso Wild Animals, Steal Player Rides, Stay In Place), Target (Best Income, Heaviest, Nearest), Island Rule (Smart, Safe Only, Any Island), selectable Catch Islands, and configurable Catch Delay.



Smart Island Selection: Uses every island where your Speed can outrun the Guardian plus the next island up. If a Guardian catches you, that island is temporarily skipped until your Speed increases.



Auto Ride:





Auto Ride: Automatically completes captured rides using Presets (Finish Line, Teleport Home), Ride Actions (Sidestep When Stuck, Teleport Home), Ride To (Finish Line, My Base), and configurable Stuck Time.

PEN & COLLECTION





Auto Pen:





Auto Pen: Automatically manages captured animals using Presets (Everything, Equip Best Only) and Pen Actions (Equip Best, Place Held Animals), with a configurable Pen Delay.



Auto Collect:





Auto Collect: Automatically collects pad income using Presets (Blatant, Level Up Too, Relaxed) and Collect Actions (Claim Pads, Level Up Pad Animals), with configurable Claim At based on stored seconds of income.

SELLING





Auto Sell:





Auto Sell: Automatically sells unwanted animals with keybind support using Presets (Keep Best, Sell Spares, Low Islands), configurable Keep rules (Alien Craft Materials, Better Than Pads, Mutations), selectable Sell Islands, and Keep Top.

MOVEMENT





Movement:





Movement: Automated navigation using Presets (Blatant, Legit, Walk) and Movement Mode (Teleport, Tween, Walk), with Teleport as the default. Includes adjustable Tween Speed and Walk Speed.

PROGRESSION





Auto Upgrade:





Auto Upgrade: Automatically manages progression using Presets (Smart Progression, Speed First, Pads First) and Upgrade Actions (Buy Treadmills, Equip Best Treadmill, Upgrade Base). Includes configurable Upgrade Order and Coin Reserve.



Auto Train:





Auto Train: Automatically keeps training active using Presets (Always, Between Catches) and Train Actions (Hold While Catching), with adjustable Re-Equip Delay.
